name: jaiscript
description: JaiScript language support: the jaiscript_lsp language server (diagnostics from the strict checker, go to definition, references, hover, completion, signature help, rename, symbols), syntax highlighting and attach debugging for the JaiScript embedded scripting language.

jaiscript.languageServer.enabled.description: Run the jaiscript_lsp language server for .jai files.

jaiscript.languageServer.path.description: Path to jaiscript_lsp. Empty: the server packaged with the extension, else the checkout's build/bin and build-debug/bin, else the Visual Studio build trees (out/build/<config>/bin), else PATH. ${workspaceFolder} is expanded.

enumDescriptions: The jaiscript runner's registrations: the standard library, file IO, console, networking, ARGS.
A fresh engine: only what every engine has.
jaiscript.languageServer.host.description: The host registration surface scripts are checked against.

jaiscript.languageServer.includePaths.description: Extra folders import and include resolve against, after the importing file's own folder (the engine's include paths).

jaiscript.languageServer.log.description: Log each request and its timing to the JaiScript Language Server output channel.

host.description: Host the JaiScript debugger listens on (jai::debug::listen binds 127.0.0.1).

port.description: Port the host logs at startup: 52477 for the standalone jaiscript runner run with --debug, 52472 (jai::debug::default_port) for a host that calls jai::debug::listen(*eng).

configurationSnippets.label: JaiScript: Attach
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to a jaiscript runner started with --debug (port 52477) or a host listening with jai::debug::listen (port 52472).
